messages:
leah_sales: Quick check: NovaHealth wants compliance addon pricing for a 12mo $180k commit. Requests: 7-year audit log retention, BYOK with HSM (customer-managed), and HIPAA BA. They asked whether we can credit the BYOK integration fee against monthly invoices instead of a lump-sum.

diego_se: tagging platform ops + legal. BYOK (customer HSM) requires validating their PKCS#11 endpoints and scheduling a secure window. BYOK integration typically involves 25-40 hours of engineering + 8 hours of security testing.

mira_legal: For HIPAA/BA + BYOK we need explicit custody language and an incident escalation matrix. If we amortize the one-time fee into invoices, add a clause that final integration must pass acceptance tests within 45 days or fee becomes due.

sam_dealdesk: Draft pricing (pre-approval):
- Standard audit logs (30d): $0.02/GB-month
- Archive retention (7y): $0.0048/GB-month additional
- Managed HSM offering: $1,600/month per account
- BYOK integration (customer HSM): $2,750 one-time + $650/month monitoring
- HIPAA BA + annual attestation: $2,200/year
Discount policy: <=10% auto, 10-18% manager, >18% director.

platform_ops: Ops caveat: 7yr retention will create latent restore costs. Recommend lifecycle policy: hot 90d, cool 1y, deep-archive remainder. If they want searchable archived logs, that requires additional indexing charges. Also if ingest >150MB/s we require dedicated ingest shards (one-time $4k).

leah_sales: NovaHealth asked for full waiver of BYOK one-time and 15% off add-ons for 12mo. They propose rolling the waived amount into monthly invoices (reduce monthly by X). Need response by Tue COB.

mira_legal: We can accept amortization if LOI includes SLA for access windows and a clawback: if they cancel before integration complete, remaining amortized amount becomes due. Also need EU data residency paragraph if they store EU patient logs.

sam_dealdesk: Given $180k commit, we can offer: 10% discount + amortize BYOK fee over first 6 months (apply as credit), OR 15% discount if they extend to 18mo. Full one-time waiver requires manager signoff.

diego_se: If we amortize the fee into invoices, ops still needs guaranteed scheduled windows. Suggest adding: "Customer must provide HSM access for 3 consecutive business days in scheduled window or additional re-scheduling billed at $200/hr."

platform_ops: Also recommend contingency line: "Nonstandard HSM appliances requiring custom drivers or field engineering billed at cost + 20%" to avoid surprises.

compliance-bot: Internal ref: https://internal.redwood.com/compliance/hsm-byo k  includes checklist and standard SLA language for retention.

leah_sales: I'll propose: 10% add-on discount + amortized BYOK credit over first 6 months + the legal clawback language. Ask NovaHealth to confirm LOI by Tue COB. If they push for 15% insist on 18mo or manager signoff.

sam_dealdesk: I'll route a manager approval request for the 15% scenario (18mo). If manager approves, I can process director routing same day.

mira_legal: I'll draft the amortization & clawback redline and the HSM access schedule. Ping me when LOI is inbound.

diego_se: I'll prep a short POC timeline: discovery (3 days), integration testing (2 weeks), cutover window (3 days), rollback plan. Attach with quote.

leah_sales: Great — thanks all. I'll update when I hear back from NovaHealth. :thumbsup:
